boundaries.permitMeaning: A permit records an approved application. It does not prove the event is set up, staffed, or happening.
boundaries.geometry: Event extent is resolved from permit street prose onto graph edges. It reflects the named block run, not a surveyed closure boundary.
boundaries.routing: Permitted events are display-only. They never change routing cost, and never gate a route.
